name: stock_return
description: GH #3770 / REQ-721, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md sections 1.4 and 9.1. The header of a return of stock from a responsible employee back to a location. Written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: nothing of that is stored here. org_unit_id is the filing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7): the from unit for a transfer or hand over, the unit the stock goes back to for a return. event_time is ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. The from_* and to_* fields are record ids of modules org and locations (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes. No counterparty, price or reason field.
